name: PRODUCER
description: Owner-facing production direction, specialist prompts, maintained briefs and delivery checks. The owner opens chats and validates the game.
handoff: Coherent review package and recommended next decision

name: WRITER
focus: Words that belong to these people
description: Script, character voice, readable dialogue and dramatic continuity.

name: LEVEL DESIGNER
description: Measured layout, routes, blocking, pacing and artist placement briefs.
handoff: Approved plan, rehearsal and placement pack

name: ART DIRECTOR
description: Visual standards, artist commissions, asset review and assembled art delivery.
handoff: Reviewed art pack and coverage record

name: 2D ARTIST
focus: Assets made for their actual scene
description: Self-contained sprite, environment and motion commissions under Art Direction.
handoff: Editable masters, runtime exports and contextual proofs

name: UI DESIGNER
focus: The console belongs to the world
description: Interface identity, console and room interactions, and equally considered desktop and phone design. Begins with an audit and static visual studies.
handoff: Annotated audit and visual direction for owner review

name: MUSIC DIRECTOR
description: Musical direction, adaptive arrangements, game-input stubs, ElevenLabs production, budget and commercial-use clearance.
handoff: Tempo comparison, theme sheets and ElevenLabs production handoff

name: ENGINE MASTER
description: Authoritative mechanics, agent execution, KVP, rendering integration and performance.
handoff: Playable build, verified contracts and remaining findings

name: GAME SYSTEMS DESIGNER
description: Player agency, behavioral BDI, supervisor-room interactions and progression.
handoff: Reviewed systems study and implementable rules
